title: FairTabGen: High-Fidelity and Fair Synthetic Health Data Generation from Limited Samples
reasoning: The paper's core focus is on algorithmic fairness and bias mitigation in healthcare data. It evaluates and benchmarks its framework using specific fairness metrics (such as Demographic Parity and Fairness Through Unawareness) to ensure equitable outcomes, making ethical considerations a central component of its evaluation methodology rather than just a peripheral section.
